title: Dave Hoover
description: "Science fiction and damsels in distress," ponders Dave Hoover wistfully. "Exactly my kind of entertainment! STAR WARS certainly had its share of both..." Hoover began his creative career in animation working on everything from FAT ALBERT to TARZAN, FLASH GORDON, THE SMURFS, and such feature films as FIRE AND ICE (with Frank Frazetta) and the first animated 3D film, STARCHASER: THE LEGEND OF ORIN. In the late '80s Hoover madc a switch to comic books, starting at DC, and eventually moving onto Marvel where he's worked on just about every book they publish. Presently, he's the regular artist on CAPTAIN AMERICA.
